title: Project Mímir
tagline: A free, project-based curriculum that takes you from zero coding experience to a career building AI agents.

paths.title: Foundations
paths.description: Set up a real developer environment, learn Python, Git and how the web works, then build your first app on a language model.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.description: How this curriculum works, how to learn effectively, and how to get unstuck.

lessons.title: How This Curriculum Works
lessons.description: The lay of the land: paths, lessons, projects and how to use them.

lessons.title: Learning How to Learn
lessons.description: Motivation, mindset, and how to avoid tutorial hell.

lessons.title: Asking for Help
lessons.description: How to ask questions that get good answers, and when to ask an AI.

lessons.title: Project: Learning Plan
lessons.description: Write the study plan you'll follow for the next year.

sections.title: Your Setup

lessons.title: Testing with pytest
lessons.description: Prove your code works and keep it working.

lessons.title: Project: Expense Tracker
lessons.description: A tested, typed command-line app that saves data to CSV.

sections.title: The Web for AI Builders
sections.description: Every model you'll use is reached over HTTP. Learn how APIs, JSON and secrets work.

lessons.title: Project: Weather CLI

sections.title: How LLMs Work

lessons.description: What it means for a model to learn.

lessons.title: Reasoning Models

paths.title: AI Engineering Core
paths.description: The everyday skills of an AI engineer: prompting, structured outputs, backends, retrieval, and, most important, evals.

lessons.title: Prompting Fundamentals
lessons.description: Clear instructions, examples and structure with XML tags.

lessons.description: Measure which prompt variant actually works best.

sections.title: Structured Outputs
sections.description: Real software needs data, not prose. Get models to return JSON you can trust.

lessons.title: JSON Schema and Pydantic
lessons.description: Define the shape of your data in code.

lessons.title: Getting Structured Output
lessons.description: Native structured outputs, libraries, validation and retries.

lessons.title: Project: Messy-Text Extractor

sections.title: Backend for AI Apps

sections.title: Minimal Frontend

lessons.description: Ship a usable interface in an afternoon.

lessons.title: Project: Docs Chatbot UI
lessons.description: A shareable web interface for your docs chatbot.

paths.title: Agentic Systems
paths.description: The heart of the curriculum. Build agents from scratch, learn when not to, connect them to the world with tools and MCP, and make them safe and measurable.
